name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or enhancement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the use case or gap this addresses.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see. If this touches an area already covered by an ADR in `docs/adr/`, note which one
and whether you think the decision needs revisiting.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about and why you didn't prefer them.

**Milestone fit**
Does this fit an existing milestone in `docs/architecture.md` (M0–M5), or is it a new one? Text-scope
features are prioritized before voice/video (M6+) — see `docs/adr/0006-voice-deferred-with-seams.md`.
